{{Quote|And Jergo&mdash;a Kubaz sellsecret&mdash;came in behind him and pulled a blaster. Jergo wanted the moss-painting. Kit wouldn’t turn it over. He nearly got himself killed. I had to lay out Jergo with a hydro-spanner|Wald|<ref name="TG" />}}
